description: SCHC adaptation layer test vectors covering unknown rule IDs, Rule 255 uncompressed fallback, port boundary compression, and compressed size validation per spec/03-adaptation.md and spec/appendix-schc.md.

vectors.name: unknown_rule_id_0xfe_rejection
vectors.description: Rule ID 0xFE (unused) must result in clean NoMatchingRuleError, not crash. Security-critical robustness vector.
vectors.provenance: Security-critical: unknown rule IDs must not cause undefined behavior or crashes.

vectors.name: unknown_rule_id_0x10_rejection
vectors.description: Rule ID 0x10 (unused, in gap between defined rules) must reject cleanly.
vectors.provenance: Gap between rules 7 and 64; must reject with NoMatchingRuleError.

vectors.name: unknown_rule_id_0x77_rejection
vectors.description: Rule ID 0x77 (unused, just below fragmentation rules) must reject cleanly.
vectors.provenance: Just below fragmentation rule 0x78; must reject with NoMatchingRuleError.

vectors.name: empty_schc_packet_rejection
vectors.description: Empty SCHC packet must reject cleanly, not crash.
vectors.provenance: Edge case: zero-length input must raise appropriate error.

vectors.name: rule255_uncompressed_fallback_ipv6_udp
vectors.description: Rule 255 (0xFF) uncompressed fallback: full IPv6+UDP packet passes through with 0xFF prefix.
vectors.provenance: Rule 255: 1-byte prefix (0xFF) + full 48-byte IPv6+UDP packet.

vectors.name: rule255_uncompressed_round_trip
vectors.description: Rule 255 round-trip: compress then decompress returns original packet.
vectors.provenance: ICMPv6 Echo Request that could match Rule 2, but forced to Rule 255 for fallback test.

vectors.name: rule255_minimal_ipv6
vectors.description: Rule 255 with minimal valid IPv6 header (no payload).
vectors.provenance: A zero-payload IPv6 packet uses Next Header 59 (No Next Header); the 40-byte header plus the Rule 255 prefix is 41 bytes.

vectors.name: port_5683_coap_default_compress
vectors.description: Port 5683 (CoAP default) compresses to 4-bit residue 0x3 under MSB(12)/LSB(4).

vectors.name: port_5680_boundary_low
vectors.description: Port 5680 (low boundary) compresses to 4-bit residue 0x0.

vectors.name: port_5695_boundary_high
vectors.description: Port 5695 (high boundary) compresses to 4-bit residue 0xF.

vectors.name: port_5679_below_range_fallback
vectors.description: Port 5679 (below compressible range) fails MSB(12) match, falls back to Rule 255.
vectors.provenance: 5679 = 0x162F; MSB(12)=0x162, does not match target 0x163.

vectors.name: port_5696_above_range_fallback
vectors.description: Port 5696 (above compressible range) fails MSB(12) match, falls back to Rule 255.
vectors.provenance: 5696 = 0x1640; MSB(12)=0x164, does not match target 0x163.

vectors.name: port_10883_mqttsn_exact
vectors.description: When both endpoints use MQTT-SN port 10883, specialized Rule 7 sends one direction bit plus the 16-bit other-port field.
vectors.provenance: Rule 7 is a specialized codec rather than a generic exact-match descriptor. It always carries PortDirection and OtherPort; the canonical both-10883 case therefore carries 17 semantic port bits.

vectors.name: rule7_link_local_unicast_valid
vectors.description: Usable link-local unicast endpoints are valid Rule 7 addresses.
vectors.provenance: Canonical fe80::/64 endpoints use IID residue mode.

vectors.name: rule7_global_to_multicast_valid
vectors.description: A usable native unicast source and scope-2 multicast destination are valid.
vectors.provenance: Rule 7 permits multicast destinations in scopes 2 through 14 and never permits multicast sources.

vectors.name: rule7_multicast_scope_14_valid
vectors.description: The upper permitted multicast scope boundary is valid.
vectors.provenance: Scope 14 is the inclusive upper boundary of the Rule 7 multicast destination range; multicast forces the shared full-address mode.

vectors.name: rule7_noncanonical_link_local_full_mode_valid
vectors.description: A valid link-local address outside canonical fe80::/64 is accepted only in full-address mode.
vectors.provenance: The fe80::/10 link-local range is valid, but IID elision is canonical only for fe80::/64.

vectors.name: rule7_unspecified_source_rejected
vectors.provenance: The unspecified address is not a usable unicast source.

vectors.name: rule7_loopback_source_rejected
vectors.provenance: Loopback cannot identify a mesh sender.

vectors.name: rule7_multicast_source_rejected
vectors.provenance: IPv6 multicast addresses are never valid packet sources.

vectors.name: rule7_ipv4_mapped_source_rejected
vectors.provenance: IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses are outside the native LICHEN Rule 7 profile.

vectors.name: rule7_unspecified_destination_rejected
vectors.provenance: The unspecified address is not a deliverable destination.

vectors.name: rule7_loopback_destination_rejected
vectors.provenance: Loopback cannot be routed to a mesh peer.

vectors.name: rule7_ipv4_mapped_destination_rejected
vectors.provenance: IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses are outside the native LICHEN Rule 7 profile.

vectors.name: rule7_reserved_multicast_scope_zero_rejected
vectors.provenance: Multicast scope 0 is reserved; Rule 7 accepts only scopes 2 through 14.

vectors.name: rule7_interface_local_multicast_rejected
vectors.provenance: Interface-local multicast scope 1 cannot traverse the mesh link.

vectors.name: rule7_reserved_multicast_scope_rejected
vectors.provenance: Multicast scope 15 is reserved; Rule 7 accepts only scopes 2 through 14.

vectors.name: rule0_compressed_size_validation
vectors.description: Rule 0 (link-local CoAP): 174-bit residue, octet-padded to 22 bytes.
vectors.provenance: Sum: 8+64+64+4+4+2+4+8+16 = 174 bits, octet-padded to 22 bytes; plus the one-byte Rule ID gives 23 bytes before the CoAP tail.

vectors.name: rule1_compressed_size_validation
vectors.description: Rule 1 (global CoAP): 286-bit residue using canonical 0200::/8 Yggdrasil prefixes.
vectors.provenance: Global addresses use MSB(8)/LSB(120): 8+120+120+4+4+2+4+8+16 = 286 bits, octet-padded to 36 bytes; plus the one-byte Rule ID gives 37 bytes before the CoAP tail.

vectors.name: rule2_compressed_size_validation
vectors.description: Rule 2 (ICMPv6 Echo): exact 23-byte fixed compressed header.
vectors.provenance: Rule 2: 8+64+64+8+16+16 = 176 residue bits = 22 bytes; the Rule ID makes the fixed compressed header exactly 23 bytes.

vectors.name: rule3_compressed_size_validation
vectors.description: Rule 3 (RPL DIO): exact 40-byte fixed compressed header.
vectors.provenance: Rule 3 residue is 8+64+64+8+8+16+8+8+128 = 312 bits = 39 bytes; the Rule ID makes the fixed compressed header exactly 40 bytes.

vectors.name: rule4_compressed_size_validation
vectors.description: Rule 4 (RPL DAO with DODAGID): exact 37-byte fixed compressed header.
vectors.provenance: Rule 4 residue is 8+64+64+8+8+8+128 = 288 bits = 36 bytes; the Rule ID makes the fixed compressed header exactly 37 bytes.

vectors.name: frag_rule79_b_to_a_ack_success_w0
vectors.description: Fragmentation Rule 0x79 B-to-A direction: ACK success window 0.
vectors.provenance: Rule 0x79 for B-to-A data per spec/03-adaptation.md:158.

vectors.name: frag_rule79_b_to_a_ack_success_w1
vectors.description: Fragmentation Rule 0x79 B-to-A direction: ACK success window 1.
vectors.provenance: Rule 0x79 for B-to-A data per spec/03-adaptation.md:158.

vectors.name: frag_rule79_b_to_a_ack_req_w0
vectors.description: Fragmentation Rule 0x79 B-to-A direction: ACK request window 0.
vectors.provenance: Rule 0x79 for B-to-A data per spec/03-adaptation.md:158.

vectors.name: frag_rule79_b_to_a_sender_abort
vectors.description: Fragmentation Rule 0x79 B-to-A direction: Sender-Abort.
vectors.provenance: Rule 0x79 Sender-Abort per spec/03-adaptation.md:158.

vectors.name: frag_rule79_b_to_a_receiver_abort
vectors.description: Fragmentation Rule 0x79 B-to-A direction: Receiver-Abort.
vectors.provenance: Rule 0x79 Receiver-Abort per spec/03-adaptation.md:158.

vectors.name: frag_endpoint_a_outbound_data
vectors.description: The lexicographically smaller full signer public key is endpoint A and emits outbound data under Rule 0x78.
vectors.provenance: Endpoint labels compare all 32 public-key octets; A-to-B data uses Rule 0x78.

vectors.name: frag_endpoint_b_outbound_data
vectors.description: The lexicographically larger full signer public key is endpoint B and emits outbound data under Rule 0x79.
vectors.provenance: Endpoint labels compare all 32 public-key octets; B-to-A data uses Rule 0x79.

vectors.name: frag_endpoint_b_reverse_ack_retains_data_rule
vectors.description: Endpoint B replies to accepted A-to-B data with an ACK that retains the data session's Rule 0x78.
vectors.provenance: ACK direction is reverse traffic, but its Rule ID identifies the data session and therefore remains 0x78.

vectors.name: frag_endpoint_b_reverse_receiver_abort_retains_data_rule
vectors.description: Endpoint B replies to A-to-B data with Receiver-Abort under the same data Rule 0x78.
vectors.provenance: Receiver-Abort retains the Rule ID of the data session it terminates.

vectors.name: frag_endpoint_equal_full_keys_rejected
vectors.description: Equal full public keys cannot be assigned distinct A/B endpoints and are rejected before session creation.
vectors.provenance: A/B is a strict full-key ordering; equality has no direction and MUST fail closed.

vectors.name: frag_endpoint_wrong_direction_rejected_before_mutation
vectors.description: Inbound data from endpoint A under B-to-A Rule 0x79 is rejected before allocating or mutating reassembly state.
vectors.provenance: Peer A may originate only Rule 0x78 data; direction validation precedes reassembly mutation.

vectors.name: octet_alignment_padding_3bit
vectors.description: Compression residue with 3 trailing bits requires 5-bit zero padding.
vectors.provenance: Per spec/03-adaptation.md:146-148, compression MUST zero-pad to octet boundary.

vectors.name: octet_alignment_padding_7bit
vectors.description: Compression residue with 7 trailing bits requires 1-bit zero padding.
vectors.provenance: Per spec/03-adaptation.md:146-148, compression MUST zero-pad to octet boundary.

vectors.name: octet_alignment_no_padding
vectors.description: Compression residue already octet-aligned requires no padding.
vectors.provenance: Per spec/03-adaptation.md:146-148, already-aligned residue needs no padding.

vectors.name: frag_duplicate_tile_idempotent_discard
vectors.description: With T=0, an authenticated duplicate of the same tile is discarded idempotently without resetting or mutating reassembly.
vectors.provenance: A byte-identical authenticated duplicate is not a distinct packet; it cannot erase accepted tiles, while its fresh link counter still advances the session high-water mark.

vectors.name: schc_rule_version_option_v2
vectors.description: SCHC Rule Version Option Type 0x13 with version 2.
vectors.provenance: SchcRuleVersionOption.to_bytes() per rules.py:213-215 and spec/03-adaptation.md:198-200.

vectors.name: schc_rule_version_option_v0_reserved
vectors.description: SCHC Rule Version Option with version 0 (reserved).
vectors.provenance: Version 0 is reserved for uncompressed fallback per spec/03-adaptation.md:189.

vectors.name: schc_rule_version_option_v255_max
vectors.description: SCHC Rule Version Option with maximum version 255.
vectors.provenance: 8-bit unsigned version field allows 0-255.

vectors.name: schc_rule_version_mismatch_rejection
vectors.description: Version mismatch between local (2) and remote (1) raises VersionMismatchError.
vectors.provenance: Per spec/03-adaptation.md:239, mismatched versions are incompatible.

vectors.name: frag_ack_bitmap_all_received
vectors.description: ACK with C=1 (all received): no bitmap, just C bit set.
vectors.provenance: C=1 means complete; no bitmap needed per RFC 8724 Section 8.3.

vectors.name: frag_ack_bitmap_single_missing
vectors.description: ACK with C=0 and bitmap showing FCN 61 missing (second tile).
vectors.bitmap_description: FCN 62 received, FCN 61 missing, unassigned FCN 60..1 zero, final All-1 received in the rightmost position
vectors.provenance: The full 63-bit final-window bitmap is 10 + sixty zeroes + 1. Removing the one trailing 1 leaves 62 bitmap bits; W=0 and C=0 make the post-Rule-ID field exactly 64 bits (0x20 followed by seven zero octets).

vectors.name: frag_ack_bitmap_multiple_missing
vectors.description: ACK with C=0 and bitmap showing FCNs 60 and 58 missing.
vectors.bitmap_description: FCN 62,61 received; 60 missing; 59 received; 58 missing; rest received up to All-1
vectors.provenance: The full bitmap is 11010 followed by 58 ones. Compression removes all 58 trailing ones, then restores one removed 1 so W=0, C=0, and bitmap prefix 11010 end on an octet: 0x35.
